嗨朋友们！本周我有一个新的工作流程，可以让你做一些很酷的事情：

1. 为您的拍摄对象或舞者添加炫酷的音频反应波效果。 （谢谢瑞安！)

2. 将输入视频中的原始舞者或主题合成到输出中。

您需要使用 ComfyUI Manager 安装我的 AKatz 自定义节点包才能使此工作流程正常工作。 （加载 wf 后，您应该能够通过“安装缺少的自定义节点”菜单进行安装）。

我发布了一个此处工作流程的视频演练。

Get early access to free workflows, guides, and exclusive content only on my Patreon Page!

Hi Friends! This week I have a new workflow that allows you to do a couple of cool things:

1. Add a cool audioreactive wave effect to your subject or dancer. (ThanksRyan!)

2. Have the original dancer or subject from your input video composited onto the output.

You will need to install my AKatz Custom Nodes pack using ComfyUI Manager for this workflow to work. (You should be able to install via 'Install Missing Custom Nodes' menu after loading the wf).

I posted avideo walkthrough of the workflow here.

And here is a written guide describing the different parts of the workflow and how to use it.

If you run into issuestry asking my custom GPT trained on info about my workflows!

Let me know if you have any questions in the comments!
